d5_rule: Danger = ANY unpaid past month (not just previous month); Completed overrides Danger when months paid >= tenure; zero-value = unpaid preserved

entries.pseudocode:
INPUT: mode in {system, light, dark} (switcher / Settings > Appearance / boot path); current html data-theme; matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)') state
OUTPUT: html root data-theme = 'light' | 'dark' for explicit modes; no explicit data-theme for system; switcher + Settings active states synced; named rejection for unknown mode
ERRORS: mode not in {system, light, dark} -> reject the switch: visible message on the control naming the rejected value, html keeps its previous data-theme, nothing else changes (FR-21)
1. Validate mode against the enum {system, light, dark}; invalid -> ERRORS path above (no attribute write).
2. mode == 'light' -> set document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', 'light').
3. mode == 'dark' -> set document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark').
4. mode == 'system' -> removeAttribute('data-theme') so ONLY the @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) block can decide tokens (D40: media query applies when no explicit data-theme).
5. OS FOLLOW (system mode): no polling and no re-apply — the CSS media query re-themes every screen the instant the OS flips; attach/update a matchMedia('...').change listener that refreshes ONLY the control indicators (the attribute for system stays absent).
6. EXPLICIT OVERRIDE: with data-theme set (light or dark), the @media block never wins — explicit Light on a dark OS stays light, explicit Dark on a light OS stays dark.
7. Sync controls: header switcher and Settings > Appearance mark `mode` active; all other modes inactive.
8. If the user initiated the change (not the boot path), call persist_theme(mode) (AF-62) AFTER a successful apply; OS-driven system flips never persist.
9. apply_theme never writes localStorage itself and never edits individual color declarations — colors live only in the two token sets (:root light, html[data-theme=dark] dark).
entries.complexity_note: constant-time attribute flip plus control sync; zero color computation — all color work is CSS token resolution
edge_cases: mode 'system' on load while OS is dark -> attribute absent, dark tokens active, switcher shows System active
explicit 'light' while OS dark -> data-theme='light' wins, @media ignored
unknown mode value from a stale control -> rejected with a visible named message, previous theme intact
system mode then OS flips light -> tokens change live, stored mode still 'system', nothing persisted
apply called twice with same mode -> idempotent (attribute and controls converge, no listener stacking — listener attach is guarded)

entries.pseudocode:
INPUT: validated mode in {system, light, dark}; localStorage key 'theme_mode'
OUTPUT: localStorage['theme_mode'] == mode (verified by read-back); visible non-blocking notice when storage is unavailable
ERRORS: invalid mode -> refuse the write (defense in depth, mode re-validated here); localStorage unavailable/quotas -> keep applied theme for the session, show a visible notice on the control, never clear the previous stored value (FR-21)
1. Re-validate mode against {system, light, dark}; invalid -> refuse, no write.
2. Write localStorage.setItem('theme_mode', mode) — OVERWRITES the previous choice (last explicit selection wins).
3. Read back localStorage.getItem('theme_mode'); mismatch -> storage failure path (step 4).
4. Storage failure (exception or read-back mismatch): do NOT revert the applied theme; surface a visible non-blocking notice on the switcher/Settings control; leave any previously stored value untouched.
5. Return success only on verified read-back so callers can confirm 'saved'.
6. Never write on OS-driven system-mode changes — only explicit user selections reach this function, so 'system' remains stored as intent across restarts.
7. Absent key is a legitimate fresh-install state (Light default) — persist is only reached after a user actually picks a mode.
entries.complexity_note: one localStorage write plus one read-back; O(1)
edge_cases: first-ever save on fresh install -> key created with the chosen mode; before that, absence means Light
user picks Dark, then Light, then reload -> stored 'light' (last write wins)
localStorage disabled -> visible notice, session theme unchanged, no crash, previous value preserved
corrupt stored value from an old build -> not written here; restore (AF-63) treats it as absent (Light) and the next explicit save repairs it

entries.pseudocode:
INPUT: localStorage['theme_mode'] read synchronously in the document <head> before first paint; default 'light' when absent/unreadable/corrupt
OUTPUT: data-theme set (light/dark) or cleared (system) on the html root BEFORE the body renders; resolved mode handed to switcher/Settings init
ERRORS: storage exception or unknown stored value -> treated as absent: boot with Light; never crash, never render unthemed (FR-21)
1. Run inside the inline bootstrap snippet (see pre_paint_theme_bootstrap_snippet) at head-parse time — before the stylesheet paints body content: this execution order IS the zero-flash guarantee.
2. Read m = localStorage.getItem('theme_mode') inside try/catch; exception -> m = null (treated as absent).
3. m not in {system, light, dark} (absent or corrupt) -> m = 'light' (fresh install default; corrupt repaired on the next explicit save).
4. m == 'system' -> document.documentElement.removeAttribute('data-theme') — the @media block resolves the OS value at first paint (zero-flash, live follow).
5. m == 'light' or 'dark' -> document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', m) — stored explicit choice renders on the very first frame.
6. Hand the resolved m to control initialization so the header switcher and Settings > Appearance open pre-selected (System/Light/Dark shown with the stored mode active).
7. Restore is READ-ONLY: no localStorage writes, no persist call — AF-62 owns writes.
8. Attach the system-mode matchMedia listener only when m == 'system' (control-indicator sync; tokens are already CSS-driven).
entries.complexity_note: single synchronous storage read plus one attribute operation; runs before first paint, O(1)
edge_cases: stored 'dark', reload -> data-theme='dark' set before body paints: no wrong-theme frame (zero-flash)
stored 'system', OS dark -> attribute absent, dark tokens from @media on frame 1
no key (fresh install) -> Light on frame 1, no error, nothing persisted
corrupt value 'blue' stored -> treated as absent -> Light, no crash
localStorage throws (disabled) -> catch -> Light default, page fully usable

entries.complexity_note: inline synchronous snippet; one storage read, one attribute operation; zero network
edge_cases: JS disabled -> attribute never set; @media + :root defaults still render a coherent theme (graceful degradation)
snippet after stylesheet but before body -> still pre-paint; brief requires head placement before stylesheet — enforced by template
double execution (template bug) -> idempotent: same input produces same attribute state

entries.pseudocode:
INPUT: tab param 'holdings' | 'payouts' (absent -> default 'holdings'); optional row param (open drawer); position registry rows (FR-53 columns); payouts grid rows (elapsed + current months)
OUTPUT: active panel only: tab echo + active panel table + counts; hidden panel absent from the response; named error for unknown tab
ERRORS: tab param not in {holdings, payouts} -> raise named error naming the value via AF-30 (never a silent default) (FR-21)
1. Route GET /portfolio resolves tab = params.get('tab', 'holdings').
2. Validate tab: not in {holdings, payouts} -> raise named error naming the offending value; render nothing half-switched.
3. tab == 'holdings' -> render the position registry panel: columns exactly Company/ISIN, Rating, Coupon, Yield, Frequency, Invested, Received, Next Payout, Status (FR-53); the + Add Position action and the detail drawer (row param) live here; status cells come from derive_payment_health (AF-67) with labels through render_label (AF-69).
4. tab == 'payouts' -> render the month-grid panel: month columns stop at the current month (future months never rendered, FR-55); rows sorted Danger -> On-going -> Matured (AF-68); cells show the ledger amount or the status chip.
5. tab state goes into the URL (?tab=...) so reload/deep link keeps the selected tab; the tab bar renders active styling + aria from the echo.
6. Emit ONLY the active panel's rows in the response — the hidden panel is never queried (one request, no disagreeing data).
7. row param resolves the drawer only against holdings rows; on payouts the drawer state is cleared, never left dangling.
8. No writes on any switch: no ledger/status/position mutation from a tab click (DATA-05).
entries.complexity_note: one route resolution plus one panel query; O(positions) for holdings, O(positions x rendered months) for the grid
edge_cases: no tab param -> holdings active (default)
?tab=payouts deep link -> payouts panel on first paint
?tab=foo -> named error naming 'foo', no silent fallback
empty portfolio -> either panel renders its empty state with counts 0 (legitimate, not an error)
row param on payouts -> no drawer; holdings rows only

entries.pseudocode:
INPUT: form fields company, isin, amount, start_date, end_date, credit_day, FR-40 display fields; computed tenure_months; bonds scan for active positions via shared lock (AF-39)
OUTPUT: one bonds row watch_state='holding' (Held) with dates, computed tenure, credit_day; OR named field/lock error with ZERO writes
ERRORS: unparseable/inverted dates, credit_day outside 1..31 (0, 32, non-integers), missing company/amount -> named error naming the field; D15 lock conflict -> 'Cannot add position: <company> has an active position (<status>)'; either aborts with zero writes (FR-21, FR-54, FR-57)
1. Read the form: company, isin, amount, start_date (date picker), end_date (date picker), credit_day (number input) + FR-40 display fields. There is NO manual tenure field.
2. TENURE AUTO-CALC: compute tenure_months = whole months between start_date and end_date (see tenure_whole_months_calc snippet): 2025-05-15 -> 2026-11-15 = 18. Display read-only in the form.
3. DATE RULES: both dates parseable AND end_date after start_date; violation -> named error naming the field, write nothing.
4. CREDIT-DAY BOUNDS: credit_day must be an integer in 1..31 — 0 -> rejected, 32 -> rejected, non-integer -> rejected, each with a named error naming the field; nothing written (FR-54, design input min 1 max 31).
5. D15 LOCK (the SHARED routine AF-39 — identical call to Move to Portfolio): company_key = trim+lower(company), isin_key = trim+upper(isin); scan ALL OTHER positions with live status On-going or Danger (engine Completed / displayed Matured EXCLUDED); name_match = stored company_key equals, isin_match = stored isin_key equals; EITHER match -> HARD BLOCK with the named error 'Cannot add position: <company> has an active position (<status>)' — no override, no force, zero writes (FR-54, D15).
6. Lock passes (no active match — including the allowed re-buy after Matured) -> INSERT one bonds row: watch_state 'holding' (purchase state Held), start/end dates, computed tenure_months, credit_day 1..31, FR-40 fields; ledger entries for the tenure window follow the existing single-master add path.
7. Post-create: the row renders in My Holdings (FR-53) and its months render in the Payouts grid (FR-55); payment health derives as On-going while paid current (AF-67) — health is NOT written at create time.
8. Sole-entry rule preserved: no add control exists on Payouts, dashboard or Watchlist (Watchlist's + Add Candidate creates a watching row only) (D16, D38).
9. Surface outcome visibly via AF-30: success names the created position; failure names the blocking position or invalid field — never redirect a block as success.
entries.complexity_note: O(positions) normalized lock scan plus one INSERT; tenure and bounds checks are constant-time
edge_cases: credit_day 0 -> rejected naming the field; credit_day 32 -> rejected; credit_day 15 -> accepted
end_date before start_date -> rejected naming the field, zero writes
duplicate company X while X On-going or Danger (name variant or ISIN variant) -> HARD BLOCK, zero rows
same X after Matured (engine Completed) -> add allowed; the new position starts On-going and re-locks
amount 0 on create -> position exists; zero = unpaid preserved feeds health as unpaid later (D5 invariant)
missing company or amount -> named field error before the lock runs

entries.pseudocode:
INPUT: candidate id (Move to Portfolio action); candidate row company, isin, watch_state, amount, start_date, end_date, credit_day; bonds scan via shared lock (AF-39)
OUTPUT: watch_state 'watching' -> 'holding' (Held) on pass; blocked verdict with the named move error (zero writes); named state errors for unknown id / already-held row
ERRORS: missing/invalid mandatory position field OR active-position lock conflict -> named move error naming the field or the blocking position + status; unknown id / already-held -> named state error; all abort with zero writes (FR-21, FR-57)
1. Resolve the candidate by id; absent -> named not-found error, no write.
2. If watch_state == 'holding' -> named 'already in Portfolio' state error, no write (idempotence explicit).
3. MANDATORY POSITION FIELDS first (a candidate may lack them): amount numeric >= 0; start_date/end_date parseable with end after start; credit_day integer in 1..31. Violation -> named move error naming the field (e.g. 'Cannot move: credit_day missing or invalid') — a candidate with holes can never become a position.
4. D15 LOCK RE-CHECK — the SAME single routine Add Position calls (AF-39; one invariant, two funnels): company_key/isin_key normalized; scan all OTHER positions with live status On-going or Danger (engine Completed / displayed Matured excluded); EITHER key match -> HARD BLOCK: named error 'Cannot move: <company> has an active position (<status>)', zero rows updated (FR-57, D15).
5. Lock pass (only Completed/Matured matches exist, or none) -> UPDATE bonds SET watch_state='holding' WHERE id=?; rowcount must be exactly 1 else the named state error (0 = raced/deleted).
6. Only watch_state changes: ledger rows, dates and FR-40 fields untouched — the candidate lands as a Held position with its history intact.
7. Post-move: the row appears in Portfolio > My Holdings with purchase state Held (FR-59), joins the Payouts grid, updates the Watchlist candidates count; health derives On-going while paid current (AF-67).
8. Re-buy flow: a move allowed after Matured restarts the lifecycle — the new position shows On-going and flips to Danger same day if its credit day passes unentered (FR-57).
9. Surface outcome visibly via AF-30: success names the moved company; block names the blocking position/field — never a redirect-as-success.
entries.complexity_note: one O(positions) normalized scan (same cost as add-time lock) plus one single-row UPDATE; field validation constant-time
edge_cases: candidate matching an On-going holding by name (case/whitespace variant) -> blocked naming the blocker
ISIN-only match with different name -> still blocked (EITHER key)
company matching only Matured (engine Completed) positions -> passes
candidate missing credit_day or amount -> blocked at field step, lock never needed, zero writes
two candidates of the same company moved back-to-back -> first passes, second blocks against the now-active first
blocked move -> Watchlist and Portfolio counts unchanged, no partial write

entries.pseudocode:
INPUT: position row (start_date, end_date, credit_day, tenure window); payment_ledger (Payouts grid) entries for the tenure window, esp. the current cycle month's entry at the credit day; today's date; day-wise/tenure arithmetic (AF-14)
OUTPUT: payment health in {On-going, Danger, Matured} + the deriving grid entry; named errors for bad dates / unreadable ledger
ERRORS: unparseable start/end/credit_day -> named error naming the field; ledger read failure -> named error naming the position; health is never guessed as On-going over an error (FR-21)
1. TENURE END CHECK FIRST: if the tenure end is reached (end_date <= today, or months paid >= tenure -> engine Completed) -> return 'Matured'. Matured dominates: the current month's entry cannot resurrect On-going/Danger for a matured position.
2. CREDIT-DAY DEADLINE: let cur = current cycle month key, entry = ledger row for cur (if any). qualifying = entry exists AND paid flag true AND amount > 0 (zero = unpaid preserved).
3. today.day < credit_day and not qualifying -> 'On-going' (due window still open — not yet entered is normal before the credit day).
4. today.day >= credit_day (the credit day arrived) and not qualifying -> 'Danger' from that SAME day onward — no entry ON the credit day means Danger that day, not at month end (day-wise rule).
5. qualifying (entered with amount > 0 on or before the credit day) -> 'On-going'.
6. DERIVATION IS READ-TIME ONLY: nothing is written — no status column stored, engine values untouched; Matured here is the display face of engine Completed (label mapping applied at render per AF-69).
7. Portfolio-only: this health renders on My Holdings Status, Payouts rows and the legend; Watchlist candidates never call it (they show Watching only).
8. Two reads over unchanged data always return the same health (pure function of position + ledger + today).
entries.complexity_note: O(tenure) worst-case ledger walk bounded by one current-month lookup in practice; pure read
edge_cases: credit day today, still unentered -> Danger same day (brief rule); entered with amount>0 today -> On-going
amount 0 entry on the credit day -> not qualifying -> Danger (zero = unpaid preserved)
tenure end reached while current month unpaid -> Matured (tenure end dominates Danger)
paid every month through tenure end -> Matured
before credit day, unentered -> On-going (window open)
unparseable credit_day in the row -> named error naming the field, not a silent On-going

entries.pseudocode:
INPUT: Payouts grid row set (positions x rendered months: elapsed + current only); per-row health from AF-67
OUTPUT: ordered rows: Danger group, then On-going group, then Matured group; stable within groups; recomputed every render
ERRORS: unknown health value -> raise named error naming the value (never silently drop the row to the bottom) (FR-21)
1. Bucket rows by health: DANGER, ONGOING, MATURED; any other value -> named error naming the value.
2. Concatenate in fixed rank order: DANGER first, ONGOING next, MATURED last (FR-55).
3. Within each bucket sort stably by company ascending, then position id — identical health never reshuffles rows between renders.
4. Run on every Payouts render; any health change (payment entry, credit-day flip, tenure end) is reflected on the NEXT render with no user action — Danger rises, Matured sinks (auto re-sort).
5. Month window precondition: columns stop at the current month — future months are never rendered, so no future column participates (FR-55).
6. Ordering is presentation only: no ledger row, health or position field is written by sorting (DATA-05).
7. The same health vocabulary is used for chips and legend (On-going/Danger/Matured) — sorted groups and chips can never disagree.
entries.complexity_note: O(n log n) over the grid's rows per render; health derivation is O(1) amortized per row (current-month lookup)
edge_cases: mixed statuses seeded -> exact order: all Danger, then all On-going, then all Matured
one row flips On-going -> Danger (credit day passed unpaid) -> next render it tops the grid
Matured row after tenure end -> sinks to the bottom on the next render
all rows same health -> stable company/id order, no churn between renders
empty grid -> empty order, no error
future month column attempted -> never rendered (window rule), nothing to sort

entries.pseudocode:
INPUT: raw render-time values/labels; fixed display mapping {'Returned': 'Received', 'Completed': 'Matured'}
OUTPUT: display strings with the mapping applied; unmapped values passed through; engine/storage untouched
ERRORS: none by design — unknown values pass through verbatim (presentation whitelist, never raises over content)
1. mapping = {'Returned': 'Received', 'Completed': 'Matured'} — fixed at the render layer (template filter/helper), not configurable, not stored.
2. For every rendered label/status cell: if raw in mapping -> render mapping[raw]; else render raw unchanged.
3. Apply at ALL surfaces: My Holdings headers/cells ('Returned' column label -> 'Received'), Payouts status chips, detail drawer, dashboard tiles, status legend, print/share snapshot (same render layer).
4. NEVER write back: the database keeps 'Completed', ledger/schema keep their names — a stored engine 'Completed' still displays 'Matured' after render, and re-reading the row proves the value unchanged (FR-58, D39).
5. Display separation: exports to CSV and all computations consume ENGINE values, not the mapped labels — the mapping never feeds a query, sort key or total.
6. Exact match only: 'On-going', 'Danger', 'Watching', 'Held' and anything else pass through verbatim; a hypothetical new engine value renders as-is instead of crashing (FR-21).
entries.complexity_note: O(1) dict lookup per rendered label; no data pass, no I/O
edge_cases: stored status 'Completed' -> DOM chip reads 'Matured'; DB row still 'Completed'
amount column header -> 'Received' on Holdings, dashboard and drawer — no surface shows 'Returned'
status 'On-going' -> unchanged (not in mapping)
engine gains a new value -> renders verbatim, no exception
grep of served HTML finds no 'Returned'/'Completed' strings outside engine internals

entries.pseudocode:
INPUT: start_date, end_date (both parseable, end after start)
OUTPUT: tenure_months = whole months between start dates (read-only form field, e.g. 18 months)
ERRORS: unparseable date or end <= start -> named error naming the field; tenure is never fabricated (FR-54)
1. whole_months = (end.year - start.year) * 12 + (end.month - start.month).
2. If end.day < start.day -> whole_months -= 1 (the final month is not yet complete — WHOLE months only, no rounding up).
3. Result must be >= 1 (a position lasts at least one whole month); 0 or negative -> invalid range error naming the dates.
4. WORKED CASE (approved design): start 2025-05-15, end 2026-11-15 -> (2026-2025)*12 + (11-5) = 18, end.day (15) >= start.day (15) -> 18 months.
5. Display read-only in the form ('Tenure (auto-calculated)'): the user never types tenure; changing either date recomputes it live.
6. The computed value is stored with the position and drives the tenure window used by health derivation (AF-67) and the Payouts grid month range — one number, same arithmetic everywhere.
edge_cases: 2025-05-15 -> 2026-11-15 = 18 months (whole-month rule holds exactly)
2025-05-31 -> 2026-06-01 -> 12 months (day 1 < day 31 -> decrement from 13)
same start and end day one month apart -> 1 month
end before start -> named error naming the field, zero writes
leap-day edge (Feb 29) -> whole-month arithmetic unaffected; only the day-of-month comparison applies the decrement rule
